newMessages.content: Task: Write a short note that explains what a password manager is.

content.text:
A password manager is a secure digital tool that stores, manages, and generates all your passwords in one place. Instead of memorizing dozens of complex combinations or reusing the same weak password across multiple sites, you only need to remember one strong "master password" to access the vault. 

Password managers improve your online security by creating unique, hard-to-crack passwords for every account and automatically filling them in when you log in.

content.text:
A password manager is a safe app that remembers all your secret login words for you. 

Instead of trying to memorize a bunch of different words for games, school accounts, and websites, you only have to remember one super-strong master password. It works like a digital treasure chest that locks your information and types it in for you automatically.

about.title: Evaluator loop: write, check, improve
about.author: Agent Atlas Academy
about.description:
A writer drafts, an evaluator checks the draft against the criteria, and the writer improves it.

**What it teaches**

A loop with a clear check makes the answer better, but only as far as the criteria say.

**What to watch**

What the evaluator asks to change, and whether round two fixes it.

Read more: [Evaluator loop](#/learn/evaluator-loop)
